findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). OUTL is specified only by OUTL (INL x) = x (sumScript.sml:286). For x outside FDOM f, the saved theorems give only FAPPLY f x = FAPPLY FEMPTY x (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY, line 562), i.e. the unspecified OUTL (INR one). No saved theorem equates it with ARB. Lean returns ARB in the none case, so it proves FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB, and hence also FAPPLY FEMPTY x = THE none and = HD []. HOL4 leaves these equations open.
findings.repair:
opaque FAPPLY_outside {β : Type} [Nonempty β] : β

def FAPPLY [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.rep x with
  | some y => y
  | none => FAPPLY_outside
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.FiniteMap

theorem fapply_fempty_arb {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) :
    CmlTS.FAPPLY (CmlTS.FEMPTY : CmlTS.fmap α β) x = (CmlTS.ARB : β) := rfl
